                                                                               CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT
                                                                                            董事長致辭




                                                    Wu Zhixiang
                                                        吳志祥
                           Co-Chairman of the Board and Executive Director
                                            董事會聯席董事長兼執行董事




I am very pleased to present you our annual report for the                      本人欣然提呈我們截至二零一九年十二月三十一
year ended December 31, 2019.                                                   日止年度的年報。


business review and ouTlook                                                     業務回顧與展望
2019 has marked another prosperous year for the Company. We continued           二零一九年是本公司另一個繁榮興旺的年度，
to achieve sustainable growth and generated solid profit, making us one         我們繼續保持增長，而且取得可觀的溢利，
of the fastest-growing companies within the industry. In the past year,         成為行內發展最快的公司之一。過去一年，憑
we further explored the tremendous opportunities in the travel market as        藉對於用戶需求獨到的掌握以及技術創新的能
well as improved our products and services by leveraging on our unique          力，我們進一步開拓旅遊市場的龐大商機以及
understanding of users’ needs and technological innovation capabilities. Our    提升我們的產品及服務，成就豐碩的成績。我
efforts paid off. We were awarded the “Best Mini Program of the Year” by        們連續兩年榮登阿拉丁指數的「年度最佳小程
Aladdin Index for the second consecutive year and the “Best Online Travel       序」，並在 2019 亞洲旅遊「紅珊瑚」獎中獲選為
Service Platform” by Red Coral Award of Asia Tourism 2019, in recognition of   「最佳在線旅遊服務平台」，肯定我們優良的產
our high quality products and services.                                         品及服務。

     CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT
     董事長致辭




     Results Highlights                                                                業績摘要
     In 2019, we have achieved outstanding financial performance. On a                 二零一九年，我們的財務表現驕人，按合併基

Foreign Exchange Risk                                                            外匯風險
Foreign exchange risk arises when future commercial transactions or              當未來的商業交易或已確認的資產及負債不是
recognized assets and liabilities are denominated in a currency that is not      以我們的功能貨幣計價時，即產生外匯風險。
our functional currency. We manage our foreign exchange risk by performing       我們通過定期審查我們的外匯淨風險敞口管理
regular reviews of our net foreign exchange exposures. We did not hedge          外匯風險。截至二零一九年十二月三十一日止
against any fluctuation in foreign currency during the year ended December       年度，我們並無對沖任何外幣波動。

development in the Prc legislation on foreign investment                    有關外國投資的中國法例的發展
On March 15, 2019, the National People’s Congress promulgated the           於二零一九年三月十五日，全國人民代表
Foreign Investment Law (外商投資法) (the “FIL”), which took effect on            大會頒佈外商投資法（「外商投資法」），該
January 1, 2020. The FIL replaces the laws regulating foreign investment    法已於二零二零年一月一日生效。外商投
in PRC, namely, the Sino-foreign Equity Joint Venture Enterprise Law,       資法取代了中國規管外商投資的法律，即
the Sino-foreign Cooperative Joint Venture Enterprise Law and the           《中外合資經營企業法》、《中外合作經營企
Wholly Foreign-invested Enterprise Law. The FIL embodies an expected        業法》及《外資企業法》。外商投資法體現出
regulatory trend in PRC to rationalize its foreign investment regulatory    預期的中國監管趨勢，疏理其外商投資規
regime in line with prevailing international practice and the legislative   管制度以符合當前國際慣例及立法措施，
efforts to unify the corporate legal requirements for both foreign and      以統一國內外投資的公司法律規定。
domestic investments.


The FIL does not explicitly stipulate the contractual arrangements          外商投資法並無明確規定合約安排為一種
as a form of foreign investment. The FIL does not mention concepts          外商投資形式。外商投資法並無提及包括
including “de facto control” and “controlling through contractual           「實際控制權」及「通過合約安排進行控制」
arrangements” nor does it specify the regulation on controlling through     的概念，亦並無具體說明通過合約安排進
contractual arrangements. Furthermore, the FIL does not specifically        行控制的規定。此外，外商投資法並無具
stipulate rules on the Relevant Businesses. Instead, the FIL stipulates     體訂明就相關業務實行的規則。相反，外
that “foreign investors invest in PRC through any other methods under       商投資法規定「外國投資者通過法律、行政
laws, administrative regulations, or provisions prescribed by the State     法規或國務院規定的其他方式在中國境內
Council”. Therefore, as advised by the PRC legal Advisor, the Contractual   投資」。因此，根據中國法律顧問的建議，
Arrangements will not be affected under the FIL.                            合約安排不會受到外商投資法影響。

  2.19 Provisions                                                                2.19 撥備
      Provisions are recognized when the Group has a present legal or               倘本集團因過往事件而現時須承擔法
      constructive obligation as a result of past events; it is probable that       定或推定責任，而履行該等責任可能
      an outflow of resources will be required to settle the obligation;            導致資源流出，且所涉及的金額能可
      and the amount has been reliably estimated. Provisions are not                靠地估計，則會確認撥備。未來經營
      recognized for further operating losses.                                      虧損毋須確認撥備。


      Where there are a number of similar obligations, the likelihood               如有多項類似責任，其需要在償付中
      that an outflow will be required in settlement is determined by               流出資源的可能性，根據責任的類別
      considering the class of obligations as a whole. A provision is               整體考慮。即使在同一責任類別所包
      recognized even if the likelihood of an outflow with respect to any           含的任何一個項目相關的資源流出的
      one item included in the same class of obligations may be small.              可能性極低，仍須確認撥備。


      Provisions are measured at the present value of the expenditures              撥備採用反映當時市場對金錢時間值
      expected to be required to settle the obligation using a pre-tax rate         及有關責任特定風險之評估之稅前比
      that reflects current market assessments of the time value of money           率，按照預期履行有關責任所需支出
      and the risks specific to the obligation. The increase in the provision       之現值計量。隨著時間流逝而增加之
      due to passage of time is recognized as interest expense.                     撥備確認為利息開支。

                  received;                                                                  融資條件的變動；


              •   uses a build-up approach that starts with a risk-free interest         •   使用累加法，首先就本集團所持有租
                  rate adjusted for credit risk for leases held by the Group, which          賃的信貸風險（最近並無第三方融資）
                  does not have recent third party financing, and                            調整無風險利率，及


              •   makes adjustments specific to the lease, eg term, country,             •   作出租賃特定的調整；例如期限、國

      31. business combinaTion                                                      31. 業務合併
          Acquisition of TCCT                                                         收購同程文化旅遊
          On April 30, 2019, the Company acquired entire equity interests in          於二零一九年四月三十日，本公司自關聯
          Suzhou Tongcheng Cultural Tourism Development Co., Ltd. (“TCCT”),           公司同程控股股份有限公司（「同程控股」）
          a company primarily providing attraction ticketing services, from a         收購蘇州同程文化旅遊發展有限公司（「同

          or indirectly, control the other party or exercise significant influence                 能對另一方的財務及經營決策行使重大影
          over the other party in making financial and operation decisions. Parties                響力，則雙方被視為關聯方。倘雙方受共
          are also considered to be related if they are subject to common control.                 同控制，亦被視為關聯方。本集團主要管
          Members of key management and their close family member of the                           理層成員及彼等的近親亦被視為關聯方。
